criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Request
categories.definition: User seeks information about COVID-19, its symptoms, transmission, or related topics.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: User expresses concerns or inquiries about travel restrictions or safety related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Health and Safety Precautions
categories.definition: User asks for advice on how to protect themselves or others from COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms Inquiry
categories.definition: User inquires about symptoms associated with COVID-19 or how to identify them.

categories.name: Myth Busting
categories.definition: User seeks clarification on myths or misinformation regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment Options
categories.definition: User asks about treatment options or remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Donation and Support
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Statistics and Updates
categories.definition: User requests current statistics or updates on COVID-19 cases and impacts.

categories.name: Animal Concerns
categories.definition: User inquires about the impact of COVID-19 on animals or transmission between species.

categories.name: Public Health Guidelines
categories.definition: User seeks information on public health guidelines or recommendations related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Economic Impact
categories.definition: User inquires about the economic effects or updates related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Personal Experience
categories.definition: User shares personal experiences or symptoms related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Vaccine Information
categories.definition: User seeks information about COVID-19 vaccines, their availability, or effectiveness.

categories.name: Community Health
categories.definition: User inquires about health measures or concerns within their community.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: User makes a general inquiry or expresses casual conversation about COVID-19.
